🗺️ IL HJRCA27 — Redistricting Plan Changes Proposed for Illinois Districts

Illinois will update its Legislative and Representative Districts to ensure equal population, equal political opportunity, and consider racial coalitions, with a new commission established to create and implement the plan by September 5th…

July 1, 2026: Rule 19(b) / Re-referred to Rules Committee.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://ilga.gov/Legislation/BillStatus?DocNum=27&GAID=18&DocTypeID=HJRCA&LegId=168319&SessionID=114
